summary: Build AI risk, impact assessment, and governance skills with NIST AI RMF-based practice. Enrol in this 5-day course.
lede: AI risk management and impact assessment gives professionals a structured way to evaluate planned or deployed AI systems and document potential harms. The course covers use-case scoping, impact assessment, and reviews of data quality, bias, and model reliability, then develops skills in mapping controls, planning risk treatments, and monitoring drift and exceptions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to assess AI risk, document impact, and strengthen governance around deployed or planned AI systems.
modules: NIST AI RMF Govern and Map
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of risk, compliance, data governance, internal audit, or AI delivery processes. No programming is required, but familiarity with AI use cases, model outputs, and basic control concepts will help you move faster. You should bring a laptop for workshop exercises, and a sample AI use case or internal policy context is useful if available. Advanced statistical modeling is not required; the course focuses on operational risk assessment and impact evaluation rather than model engineering.
